# AEO Toolkit — Complete Reference

> Free, open-source tools that audit and improve how AI assistants see your website. One URL in, complete AI Readiness Score out.

Built by Patrick Mitchell / Boxford Partners (https://www.boxfordpartners.com), an AI operations consultancy for service and B2B businesses.

## Tools

### AEO Pipeline
Full AI readiness scan. Enter a URL and get an interactive dashboard with scores across three dimensions: technical visibility, content quality, and agent readiness. Returns a 0-100 combined AI Readiness Score with plain-language explanations and a prioritized action plan.

Usage:
```
git clone https://github.com/patrickboxfordpartners/rote-playoffs.git
cd rote-playoffs
python3 -m aeo_pipeline yoursite.com
```

No API keys required for core functionality. Optional multi-agent mode with Firecrawl, OpenAI, or Anthropic keys for LLM-generated insights.

### AI Visibility Audit
Technical scoring across four dimensions:
- AI Crawler Access (25 points): robots.txt, llms.txt, sitemap.xml, bot-specific policies
- Structured Data (30 points): JSON-LD, @graph, schema types, Open Graph, Twitter Cards
- Content Citability (25 points): heading hierarchy, word count, Q&A patterns, lists, tables
- Entity & Authority (20 points): author schema, social links, brand consistency, contact/about pages

Returns a 0-100 score with copy-paste fix recommendations sorted by impact.

Usage:
```
python3 score.py yoursite.com
```

### Content Quality Engine (AEO Writer)
Analyzes text against five citability signals that determine whether AI assistants will cite your content:
1. Burstiness — sentence length variation (real writers mix short and long)
2. Vocabulary — checks for overused filler words that signal templated content
3. Hedging — detects weak qualifiers (AI prefers definitive statements)
4. Monotony — measures repetitive paragraph structure
5. Specificity — looks for concrete details like numbers, names, and data points

Works on files or URLs. Returns a 0-100 citability score with per-signal breakdown and specific improvement suggestions.

Usage:
```
python3 -m aeo_writer detect path/to/article.md
```

### MCP Server
Model Context Protocol server for Claude Desktop and Claude Code integration. Three tools:
- audit_url: AI visibility score (0-100) for any URL
- analyze_content: Content citability analysis (5 signals)
- full_pipeline: Complete AI readiness assessment

Install via Rote Play:
```
rote play run aeo-mcp-setup
```

## Rote Plays (Hackathon Registry)
Available on the Rote registry at play.modiqo.ai:
- patrickmitchell/aeo-pipeline — Full AI readiness scan with dashboard
- patrickmitchell/ai-visibility-audit — Technical visibility scoring
- patrickmitchell/aeo-writer — Content citability analysis
- patrickmitchell/aeo-mcp-setup — One-command MCP server installation

- Language: Python 3.10+
- Dependencies: None for core audit (stdlib only). Optional: firecrawl-py, openai, anthropic
